goal: Add usage-based invoicing to the billing service without breaking the flat-rate path.
now: Two workers implementing milestone 2; waiting on the user for the Stripe test key.

steps.title: Integration tests through the real seam

agents.name: research-stripe
agents.task: Document Stripe metered billing: usage records, aggregation, and invoice timing.
agents.brief: Done when docs/research/stripe-metered-billing.md cites primary sources for usage record creation, aggregation modes, and when metered lines appear on invoices.
agents.report: Written with 6 citations. Aggregation is per subscription item; usage must be reported before the invoice finalizes.

agents.name: map-invoice
agents.task: Explain the invoice module's interface and where usage would enter.
agents.brief: Read-only. Done when the report names every caller of generateInvoice and the one seam usage can enter through.
agents.report: generateInvoice has 3 callers. Usage enters through the line-item builder; the flat-rate path never touches it.

agents.name: usage-store
agents.task: UsageRecord type and an in-memory plus SQL store behind one interface.
agents.brief: Done when src/billing/usage/store.test.ts is green against both adapters and the diff stays inside src/billing/usage.
agents.report: 12 tests green. Both adapters share the same interface test. No files touched outside the lane.

agents.name: invoice-gen
agents.task: Invoice generator adds metered line items from the usage store.
agents.brief: Done when the flat-rate invoice tests still pass and a new test shows a metered line item for a subscription with usage.

agents.name: stripe-adapter
agents.task: Stripe adapter that reports usage for metered prices.
agents.brief: Done when reportUsage is exercised against the Stripe test mode with a recorded fixture.
agents.report: Adapter written; cannot record the fixture without a Stripe test key.

roadblocks.title: Stripe test key needed
roadblocks.detail: stripe-adapter needs STRIPE_TEST_KEY in the environment to record the usage-report fixture.

roadblocks.title: Lane overlap on line-item builder
roadblocks.detail: invoice-gen and usage-store both wanted src/billing/invoice/line-items.ts. Assigned to invoice-gen; usage-store exposes a function instead.

decisions.title: Stripe test key
decisions.question: Where is the Stripe test key?
decisions.why: stripe-adapter cannot record the usage-report fixture without it

decisions.title: Rounding of usage quantities
decisions.question: Round a fractional usage quantity up, or bill the fraction?
decisions.why: invoice-gen bills the fraction until you say otherwise

options.label: Bill the fraction
options.consequence: Invoices show quantities like 12.4. Matches what Stripe meters.

options.label: Round up
options.consequence: Whole quantities on the invoice. Customers pay for usage they did not have.

decisions.reason: It is what the meter records, so the invoice and Stripe's figures agree.
